investigation_notes.Description: An Office 365 login for Elena.Vasiliev@client.ee occurred from Singapore, Singapore, outside the user's typical Tallinn, Estonia region. Source IP 103.1.64.118 maps to a data center hosting provider (China Unicom Global IP Service) and is not associated with VPN or proxy usage; MFA was completed and the login succeeded. Historical activity shows logins from Estonia, with no prior Singapore activity, making the combination of unusual geography and hosting-origin IP suspicious and warranting High Priority assessment.
